// Footwork / Juke pattern for Strudel × Stims
// 160 BPM, syncopated kicks, rolling hats, sub bass

stack(
  // Kicks - classic footwork syncopation
  s("<bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd>")
    .gain(1.3)
    .speed(1),
  
  // Rolling hats - 16th note feel with accents
  s("hh*16")
    .gain("[0.4 0.8 0.3 0.6]*4")
    .speed(1),
  
  // Snares on 2 and 4 with ghost notes
  s("[~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~] [~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ sd ~]")
    .gain(1),
  
  // Sub bass - follows kick pattern, octave down
  note("<c1 ~ c1 c1 ~ ~ c1 ~ c1 ~ c1 c1 ~ ~ c1 ~ c1>")
    .s("sine")
    .lpf(80)
    .gain(1.5),
  
  // Mid synth - stabs on off-beats
  note("<~ [eb2 g2] ~ ~ ~ [f2 ab2] ~ ~ ~ [g2 bb2] ~ [c3 eb3] ~ ~>")
    .s("sawtooth")
    .lpf(1200)
    .gain(0.6)
    .room(0.4),
  
  // Vocal chops / samples - sporadic
  s("vocal*4")
    .gain("[0 0.3 0 0.4]*2")
    .speed("[1 1.5 0.5 2]")
    .bank("github:tidalcycles/dirt-samples")
)  

// Alternative: More aggressive "juke" variant
